name: RegionDet
description: Object detection is a fundamental task in computer vision and has achieved remarkable progress on standard benchmarks by localizing discrete and well-bounded object instances. However, many visual targets in real-world scenarios are not individual objects, but regions defined by visual states, scene context, object relations, and human activities, such as construction areas, damaged road regions, queues, group conversations, and vendor regions. Existing detection benchmarks are mainly built around object instances, providing limited support for systematically evaluating such region targets.
